qa.title: Q941 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: What is ability damage?
qa.answer: Ability damage is damage from non-combat sources, including damage from spells and follower abilities. Damage from Strike abilities, although triggered by combat, is considered ability damage.

qa.title: Q952 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: If Kaguya is on my field, and I play this amulet, is it possible to banish an enemy Electromagical Rhino with 7 defense with this amulet's Fanfare ability?
qa.answer: Yes, it is, but only if you resolve the abilities in the correct order. Kaguya's non-Fanfare ability and this amulet's Fanfare ability are triggered simultaneously, so you may resolve them in any order. To banish an enemy with 7 defense, you must first resolve Kaguya's ability to deal 3 damage to that enemy. Then, since that enemy now has 4 defense, you can select it and banish it with this amulet's ability.

qa.title: Q960 (Oct. 8, 2024)
qa.question: Does this follower's ability mean that it can only take 3 damage a turn?
qa.answer: No, it means that any instance of damage dealt to this follower will be reduced to 3 if it exceeds 3 damage. For example, if this follower is attacked by two enemy followers with 4 attack, it will only take 3 damage from each attack. However, if this follower is attacked by an enemy follower with 4 attack and an enemy follower with 2 attack, it will take 3 damage and 2 damage from each attack respectively.
